englishSummary.headline: Last used app governance policies are temporarily unavailable
englishSummary.summary: Administrators cannot create policies using the Last used condition. Evaluation of existing policies using it is paused, so they do not generate alerts or execute governance actions; their configurations remain unchanged.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Policies using Last used may create monitoring and enforcement gaps while evaluation is paused. No required configuration change is stated.

 App governance provides customizable policies for unused apps, apps with unused credentials, and apps with expiring credentials.
 
+Note
+
+You temporarily can't create app governance policies that use the **Last used** condition. Evaluation of existing policies that use this condition is also paused, so affected policies don't generate alerts or execute governance actions. Existing policy configurations remain unchanged, and policy evaluation will resume when normal operation is restored.
+
 For example, create a policy to automatically disable any app that hasn’t been used in the past 90 days, has high privilege permissions, and can access [priority accounts in Microsoft 365](/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/setup/priority-accounts). Like all app governance alerts, these alerts are aggregated into incidents in your Defender alerts queue and flow to Advanced hunting and Microsoft Sentinel.

englishSummary.headline: The Last used policy condition is temporarily unavailable
englishSummary.summary: The documentation states that new policies cannot use the Last used condition, and existing policies using it are not evaluated. Their configurations remain unchanged.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Affected policies will not generate alerts or execute governance actions while evaluation is paused.
